title: Artemis v2 file IO metadata
description: Select a definition by direction and kind. Replies reuse the original request's domain, kind, epoch and request ID. The message envelope carries the binary payload separately from this JSON metadata.

statRequest.description: IO domain, kind 1. Empty binary payload.

statReply.description: IO domain, kind 1. Empty binary payload.

readRequest.description: IO domain, kind 2. Empty binary payload. Offsets and lengths are in bytes.

readReply.description: IO domain, kind 2. On success the binary payload contains the actual bytes read at the requested offset. On failure the payload is empty.

writeRequest.description: IO domain, kind 4. The binary payload contains either the entire file or the chunk at the given offset. Size denotes the final file size in bytes.

writeReply.description: IO domain, kind 4. Empty binary payload. Replies to chunked requests must include the transaction ID and next offset. Staged acknowledges a non-final chunk. Ok confirms atomic replacement.

deleteRequest.description: IO domain, kind 5. Empty binary payload.

deleteReply.description: IO domain, kind 5. Empty binary payload. Ok confirms deletion.

writeAbort.description: Core to Host, IO domain, kind 6. Reliable notification with request ID zero and empty binary payload. Discard staged data for the transaction.

cancelIo.description: Host to Core, Runtime domain, kind 18. The message envelope has request ID zero and an empty binary payload. The metadata identifies the delivered request in the current session epoch.

modified_utc_ms.description: UTC Unix time in milliseconds. Absent or null if unknown.

uint64.description: Canonical unsigned 64-bit decimal string. Its numeric value must fit in 64 bits.

int64.description: Canonical signed 64-bit decimal string. Its numeric value must fit in 64 bits.
